step1_analysis.description: A high-speed differential driver circuit intended for optical modulators. It consists of cascaded amplifier stages and source followers to provide wideband amplification and level shifting.

paper_reference.title: A 10Gb/s 6Vpp Differential Modulator Driver in 0.18μm SiGe-BiCMOS

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency or mid-band AC voltage gain of the driver.

sky130_expected.calculation: Using sky130 NMOS with gm ~ 1-5mS and 50 ohm load, single stage gain is low. Cascaded stages might yield 5-10dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: CMOS 0.18um has lower transconductance than SiGe HBTs, so the gain will likely be lower than the paper's reported 10dB when driving 50 ohms.

bandwidth.description: The 3dB frequency where the gain drops by 3dB from its mid-band value.

sky130_expected.calculation: fT of sky130 is around 40-50GHz. Circuit bandwidth will be a fraction of this.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SiGe BiCMOS has much higher fT (often >100GHz) compared to standard 130nm CMOS. The bandwidth will be significantly reduced in SKY130.

power_dissipation.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit.

paper_reported.value: Not explicitly given, but high for 6Vpp

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming 5 branches with ~5mA each at 1.8V supply.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Scaled down supply (1.8V vs 5-6V) will reduce total power, but high-speed drivers still require significant bias currents.

transient_delay.description: Time delay from the input crossing 50% to the output crossing 50%.

sky130_expected.calculation: RC delays in 130nm node for cascaded stages.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Slower transit times in 130nm CMOS compared to SiGe HBTs will increase the propagation delay.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC gain, bandwidth, and transient voltage swing of the modulator driver.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Modulator Driver Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u
.param W_xm12=5u L_xm12=0.5u
.param W_xm13=5u L_xm13=0.5u
.param W_xm14=5u L_xm14=0.5u
.param W_xm15=5u L_xm15=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N33 LABEL_NET_0 N34 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N9 N17 N19 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N9 N23 N20 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 N34 N21 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N1 N22 N23 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N32 N18 N26 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N15 N32 N35 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N26 LABEL_NET_2 N12 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N35 N12 N24 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N20 N30 N14 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N9 N31 N25 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}
XM12 N23 N16 N13 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm12} w={W_xm12}
XM13 N21 N29 N16 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm13} w={W_xm13}
XM14 N19 LABEL_NET_4 N27 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm14} w={W_xm14}
XM15 N34 LABEL_NET_5 N29 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm15} w={W_xm15}

* Power Supply
VDD VDD 0 1.8

* Pull-up resistors for floating drains
R_N33 N33 VDD 50
R_N9 N9 VDD 50
R_N0 N0 VDD 50
R_N1 N1 VDD 50
R_N15 N15 VDD 50

* Ground connections for floating sources
V_N24 N24 0 0
V_N14 N14 0 0
V_N25 N25 0 0
V_N13 N13 0 0
V_N27 N27 0 0

* DC Bias Sources
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9

* Input Signals (AC and Transient)
V_N17 N17 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 sin(0.9 0.2 1G)
V_N22 N22 0 dc 0.9 ac -1 sin(0.9 -0.2 1G)
V_N18 N18 0 dc 0.9
V_N30 N30 0 dc 0.9
V_N31 N31 0 dc 0.9

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power_watts = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power_watts

* 2. AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 1M 100G
let gain_db = vdb(N9)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10M
let gain_3db = midband_gain - 3
meas ac bw_hz when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1
print midband_gain bw_hz

* 3. Transient Analysis for Swing and Delay
tran 5p 5n
meas tran vout_max max v(N9)
meas tran vout_min min v(N9)
let vpp_swing = vout_max - vout_min
print vpp_swing

quit
.endc
